statement.p: Find the perimeter and area of the parallelogram above. Side lengths are measurements.

solution.p: Perimeter is the sum of the sides: \displaystyle{2}{\left({7.02}+{6.99}\right)}={28.02}\approx{28.02}.
Area is height times base (side perpendicular to height): \displaystyle{6.99}\cdot{6.46}={45.1554}\approx{45.2}.
